channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLbreakingNews, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Neuroscientist describes growing human brain tissue in mice
item.description: Researchers at Stanford University grew human brain tissue inside mice, aiming to advance the development of future treatments.

item.title: Trump announces deal for permanent security control in Greenland
item.description: President Trump said he reached a deal granting the U.S. permanent control over security in Greenland, following his push to expand American influence there.

item.title: Trump says Donald Trump Jr. repaid Russian oligarch for wedding party
item.description: The president and the Trump Organization have not provided evidence that the repayment occurred.

item.title: Rising heating costs expected to deepen price pressures
item.description: A report showed heating costs are set to rise at twice the rate of inflation.
